findings.description: get_help_record is documented to give an undocumented argument an empty description, but it returns self.make_metavar(ctx), self.help. When help is None, the tuple's second element is None rather than "".
findings.rationale: Trigger: a command where at least one Argument has help set and another has help=None. format_help_text then calls formatter.write_dl with a (metavar, None) row. write_dl handles the second element as a string (wrapping/measuring), so it raises a TypeError or AttributeError and --help crashes. The old code substituted "" for this case.
